justification: Caleb's not Out, not Doubtful — Chicago's got the week off, and you can't play a man with no kickoff, that's not sitting my quarterback, that's math. Brissett's been the bridge since Week 4 for exactly this reason and he's got a real number next to his name tonight in Baltimore, 13.3, and the arm to back it up. Jeanty and Judkins stay up top because they're the backs taking the top off a defense right now, not committee ghosts. Downs and Brown hold at receiver — Burden's on the same Chicago bye as Caleb and Harrison's Out in Houston, so there's no upgrade hiding on my bench, just two guys who can't suit up today. Kincaid holds at tight end over Goedert for the same reason — Philly's on a bye too, that's not a benching, that's a calendar. Pollard stays in the flex over a Skattebo game that already kicked without him in it; I don't get credit for hindsight on a locked box score. Reichard and the Lions D round it out because the house isn't on fire and I'm not redecorating it. Patricia keeps a ledger — let her write this one down too: we cobble a lineup from whatever's standing and we still play it straight at her throat.
